aiPro.a: AI Pro is the mode that automatically updates session settings by looking at the measurements coming from the sensors during the session (temperature, field strength, camera image). YOU always start the session and YOU stop it; emergency stop and the time limit always take priority. The device does not start a session on its own or without veterinarian supervision — the final decision and responsibility belong to the veterinarian.
aiPro.q: What is AI Pro? Does it start a session on the animal on its own?

arastirma.a: For university, laboratory and R&D teams: it includes research tools such as tumor phantom and electromagnetic field measurement, well plate analysis, kidney RNA, computed tomography and pathology models. It is not needed for daily clinical practice — the Veterinarian profile is sufficient.

deneme.a: No charge is made when the trial period ends; we do not ask for card details in the first place. Your account keeps working at the free Starter level: 50 credits per month and 1 device. The app, your patient records and device control stay exactly as they are. If you need more analyses, you choose a plan from your account. (Because all plans are free during the test phase, no restriction is applied right now.)
deneme.q: What happens at the end of the 14-day trial?

guncelleme.a: No. All updates of the app, the device software and the AI models are included in your plan.

internet.a: An internet connection is needed for the first installation and for updates. After installation the AI models run on your device and your clinic data is kept encrypted on the device — the internet is not required for sessions, emergency stop and sensor monitoring. An AI analysis, however, does need the internet: the credit for each analysis is deducted online from your account, and a new analysis cannot be started while offline (a running session is not affected). The internet is also used for updates, account verification and (if you turned it on) access from outside the clinic. Your plan sets how many AI analyses you can run each month (see “What is the difference between Pro and Pro+?”).

iptal.a: You cancel with “Cancel subscription” in the “My account” menu; after a short confirmation step automatic renewal stops and you are not charged again. The refund conditions are written in the Distance Sales Agreement and the Pre-Contract Information Form; if you have questions, write to {{email}}.
iptal.q: How do I cancel my subscription? Will I be refunded?

isletim.a: Currently Windows 10/11 (64-bit) computers and Android 8.0+ phones. macOS and Linux versions are in preparation; they will appear on the Download page when they are ready.

jeton.a: A credit is the unit of AI analyses: an image, audio or sensor analysis uses 1 credit; heavy research models (pathology, RNA, tomography) use 3 credits; AI Pro’s automatic session uses 5 credits per session. Your plan is renewed every month with a certain credit allowance; if your allowance runs out you can buy an extra pack. ⚠️ Credits are only for AI ANALYSIS: starting a session, continuing a running session, emergency stop, sensor monitoring and device control are INDEPENDENT of credits — even if your credits run out, sessions and emergency stop are not blocked.
jeton.q: What is a credit, and what is it spent on?

jetonBitince.a: When your credits run out you cannot start a new AI analysis; the treatment side is not affected (sessions, emergency stop and sensor monitoring keep working). You can continue right away by buying an extra pack. Your plan’s monthly allowance renews each period and does not carry over to the next month; by contrast, the credits you buy have no expiry — they stay in your account until you use them. An AI analysis needs the internet: the credit is deducted online from your account when the analysis runs; a new analysis cannot be started while offline (a running session is not affected).
jetonBitince.q: What happens if I run out of credits? What happens to credits I do not use?

kullandikca.a: You do not pay a monthly fee and you do not buy credits upfront. You register your card once; you are charged only for the analyses you run, at ₺2.90 per credit. If you run no analysis in a month, no charge is made. Your spending is billed together at the end of the month. If unbilled usage reaches 300 credits, no new analysis can be started until payment is received — so you never get an unexpectedly large bill. ⚠️ This limit applies only to AI analyses: starting a session, continuing a running session, emergency stop and sensor monitoring work under all conditions. If you regularly run more than 340 analyses a month, the Pro plan costs less.
kullandikca.q: How does Pay as You Go work?

neden.a: The app and the AI models take up several gigabytes and are updated often. The launcher downloads only the parts that changed; so updates after the first installation are small and fast, and you do not download a large file every time.
neden.q: Why don't I download the app directly?

proProPlus.a: Both have the same app and the same AI models; the difference is the monthly credit allowance, the number of devices and the support speed. Pro: 500 credits per month, connection of up to 5 devices, support within 1 business day. Pro+: 2,000 credits per month, connection of up to 15 devices, priority support within the same business day. If your clinic has a single device and a few hundred analyses a month are enough, Pro is sufficient in most cases; if your credits run out you can buy an extra pack on either plan.
proProPlus.q: What is the difference between Pro and Pro+?

program.a: We call the small installer you download from the site the “launcher” (the downloaded file is named PEMFVetClient-Setup-….exe). You complete the installation in a few clicks; when the program opens, it downloads and installs the actual PEMF Vet app — including the AI models and device software — for you, and when it finishes you open it with “Start”. It also brings later updates; you never download a file again.
program.q: What exactly is the program I downloaded?

telefon.a: The phone app is a full remote control that connects to the device in your clinic: you can start and stop sessions, change coil settings, watch sensor measurements live, trigger an emergency stop and look at patient records. Because the device is connected to the computer in the clinic, that computer must be on; you reach it directly when on the same network and over a secure connection when away. You sign in with the same account as on the desktop.
telefon.q: What is the phone app for?

surum.n1: Fixes the window freezing at start-up; closing while idle no longer wrongly carries a “previous session emergency stop” warning over to the next start.
surum.n2: The apps can now also be used in English (Settings › “Dil / Language”); the setup and uninstall windows are in Turkish or English too.

uyari.tibbi: PEMF Vet is clinical support software designed to be used under the supervision of a veterinarian. Smart diagnosis and AI analysis outputs are for information only; they do not replace the veterinarian’s medical diagnosis, decisions and treatment. Autonomous session (AI Pro) features are used under the veterinarian’s responsibility.
